schema.label: Design
schema.text: LANCE is an open-label single-center randomized noncomparative phase II selection trial of FLASH versus conventional electron radiotherapy for localized cutaneous squamous cell or basal cell carcinoma that is not suitable for surgery.

schema.label: Randomize
schema.text: Patients are allocated to FLASH or conventional radiotherapy. Dose depends on lesion size. Inclusion and exclusion details are in Table 1.

arms.label: Small lesion, FLASH
arms.text: T1, 20 mm or smaller: 22 Gy in one fraction. 9 MeV electrons, 10 pulses of 2.2 Gy at 90 Hz, mean dose rate 220 Gy/s.

arms.label: Small lesion, conventional
arms.text: 22 Gy in one fraction at about 2 to 8 Gy/min with 10 MeV electrons and a 5 to 10 mm bolus.

arms.label: Large lesion, FLASH
arms.text: T2, over 20 mm to 40 mm: 30 Gy in 5 fractions of 6 Gy in less than 2 weeks. Each fraction is 3 pulses of 2 Gy, mean dose rate 270 Gy/s.

arms.label: Large lesion, conventional
arms.text: 30 Gy in 5 fractions of 6 Gy in less than 2 weeks at a conventional dose rate.

eligibility: Localized T1 or T2, N0 M0 cutaneous squamous cell or basal cell carcinoma. Surgery is declined or not possible, as judged by the tumor board.

registry_schema.label: Design
registry_schema.text: This is an open label, non-randomized study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of the combination of larotrectinib followed by 131I therapy for patients with NTRK fusion differentiated thyroid cancer. The primary Phase II objective will be to evaluate the pulmonary structural response rate at 18 months to the combination of larotrectinib given for 6-months followed by 131I therapy.

arms.label: Larotrectinib monotherapy with 131I therapy
arms.text: Patients will receive larotrectinib monotherapy for 6 months at the FDA-approved dose. Patients will receive 131I therapy after 6 months of larotrectinib. Larotrectinib will be continued for 5 days after RAI therapy and then patients will enter a wait and see period off treatment. Patients who experience disease progression at any point while on larotrectinib will proceed to 131I therapy and discontinue larotrectinib.

registry_schema.text: This is an interventional, open label, trial of definitive hypofractionated radiotherapy for patients with locally advanced pancreatic cancer. Within this study radiotherapy shall be delivered with active scanning particle-therapy using proton- or carbon ions radiotherapy. Particle therapy will be performed with a simultaneous integrated boost (SIB) treating a larger target volume, including elective lymph node stations and neural plexus, at a lower dose and boosting macroscopic disease. registry_schema.label: Design
registry_schema.text: Patients with estrogen receptor/ progesterone receptor-positive oligometastatic breast cancer with disease controlled after at least six months of systemic therapy will be enrolled in the study. Patients will be randomized to receive local therapy for oligometastatic sites in addition to systemic therapy or systemic therapy alone. Local therapy strategies will include surgery, radiotherapy, and radiofrequency ablation.
